item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Cryogenic charged-particle detector for space telescopes (Univ. GENOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. GENOVA, Genova
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-01 Fisica sperimentale delle interazioni fondamentali e applicazioni

Space telescopes designed to observe the distant universe and low-intensity sources require anticoincidence detectors to suppress noise caused by cosmic rays. The project entails developing micromachined silicon detectors featuring superconducting Transition-Edge Sensors (TES) designed for operation at the telescope's focal plane temperature of 50 mK. Specifically, this project is part of the detector development for the European Space Agency’s future X-ray astrophysics telescope, newATHENA, under the coordination of the Italian Space Agency. item.description:

Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-02 Fisica teorica delle interazioni fondamentali, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

The project aims to develop and validate learning rules that are local in space and time for recurrent neural networks, based on the geometry of stable states and compatible with low-power neuromorphic processors. Activities include theoretical analysis for continuous and finite-precision units, convergence analysis, assessment of scalability and performance in online, continual and few-shot learning, quantization of weights and activations, and validation on emulators and physical hardware. Accuracy, energy consumption and memory usage will be measured.
